modules.description: Voice engine (LiveKit Agents, INI-012) in voice/engine/ — AgentSession (streaming, turn-taking, VAD, barge-in, preemptive-gen), provider registry + profiles remote/local (STT voxtral/deepgram/whisper, TTS cartesia/kokoro, VAD silero, turn livekit), voices catalog. Runs EMBEDDED in the server process (AgentServer, job_executor_type=THREAD). LLM providers = nucleo (the «Colmena» FlashBrain, default) + baselines direct/local + raw vendors (voice/engine/llm/providers/{nucleo,direct,local,…}.py). Top level = brain-agnostic contract kept pure: tag_protocol, speech, brain_notes, proactive, prompt, health_state, llm_health, observer (SSE).

Voice interface as a self-contained ES-module app (no build) — reactive core, services (LiveKit client via session-lk.js + vendored SDK in vendor/, audio/SSE), components, widget desktop. Solid-migration-ready. index.html is a thin bootstrap.

FastAPI app + routers + module entrypoint (python -m server). Runs the LiveKit agent worker EMBEDDED in-process. HTTP: livekit_api (token + connect config + session.js swap), voice_api (voices/settings/status/events SSE), widgets, pages.

Full-stack widgets (data.py + widget.js per folder), generator, catalog, runtime. Two kinds in manifest.json — `passive` (default) and `backed` (INI-016): a backed widget declares an owner.py (async start/stop/handle) run under widgets/supervisor.py in the server lifespan (mailbox + restart-with-backoff + disable after N fails, all traced via voice/observer.py); owner is the SOLE writer of its data dir, the face READs + ENQUEUEs (server_api._route_backed); generic GET /widgets/{id}/asset/{name} serves binary media. First backed widget = `navegador` — a real web browser inside zaelar (headless Chromium via Playwright: navigates the public web, screenshots the viewport, mounts YouTube embeds; needs `python -m playwright install chromium`). Also includes the hand-built `mensajeria` widget (INI-015) — the UNIFIED messaging surface (WhatsApp + Telegram + future email) backed by connectors/messaging: a single flat list by urgency with per-platform badges, per-platform connection cards with inline QR, controlled by voice ([[msg.*]]) and click. Replaced the former `whatsapp` widget. **V2-008:** `mensajeria` is now a `backed` widget with a `"gate":"nucleo"` (owner.py) — under BRAIN=nucleo the supervisor starts its owner (subscribes to the bus `connector.msg`/`connector.status`, triages IN the widget with its internal triage_agent = LOCAL model, dumps content to memory, publishes `msg.mark_read`); under duo/hermes the gate skips the owner and the widget behaves as the passive one of before (connectors write the store directly). The gate is a general backend mechanism (any backed widget can require a brain mode).

Runtime config MANAGED FROM THE UI (gitignored JSON the frontend writes; store wins over .env). settings.py/settings.json = ⚙ panel (STT/TTS/voice/language). connectors.py/connectors.json = connector enable flags + credentials (Telegram api_id/api_hash) entered in the messaging widget, with a redacted public view (secrets never returned to the frontend). Product invariant: install once, then everything from the interface — no .env editing by end users (INI-015; see zaelar-conventions.md §Configuration is UI-managed).

External service connectors. meshkore/ = native multi-cluster WebSocket I/O channel (a third input/output next to voice & chat) — brain-agnostic transport + a bridge that injects cluster messages into the brain and routes [[cluster.*]] tags out, with an event/heartbeat driver for autonomous agent-to-agent collaboration, and a security guard (meshkore/security.py) that fences untrusted peer input against prompt injection and blocks/redacts secrets & identity leaks on the way out. architect/ = Architect code/project provider — voice-driven remote control of the shared MeshKore daemon (list/create projects, async asks to each project's architect-master via [[architect.*]] tags; results return through proactive voice + [SISTEMA] brain notes; operator-only, token in .env). whatsapp/ = WhatsApp triage connector (INI-014, WIP) — VENDORED Baileys bridge from Hermes (connectors/whatsapp/bridge/, patched: mark-read endpoint + observe mode, update-safe vs `hermes update`) reads the operator's personal WhatsApp (QR-linked device); zaelar triages the stream with a LOCAL classifier (qwen2.5:3b via Ollama, nothing personal leaves the machine, remote fallback via WA_TRIAGE_MODEL), surfacing only what matters through proactive voice + [SISTEMA] notes and marking-read what was summarized. Classifier does NOT go through the Hermes agent (preserves the ACP voice invariant + privacy). Read-only + mark-read; auto-responder deferred (Fase 4). telegram/ = Telegram triage connector (INI-015) — a Telethon USERBOT (personal account, NOT the Bot API → it can read personal chats), linked by QR shown IN the canvas (generated with segno). Pure-Python in-process asyncio, NO Hermes dependency and NO vendored bridge ("black-box lib", unlike WhatsApp) — Hermes only ships the Bot API. Same read-only + mark-read (send_read_acknowledge) discipline. messaging/ = SHARED messaging layer both connectors build on: triage.py (the LOCAL platform-agnostic classifier, promoted from whatsapp — qwen2.5:3b via Ollama, nothing personal leaves the machine, remote fallback via MSG_TRIAGE_MODEL, never through the Hermes agent), store.py (the UNIFIED store widgets/_data/mensajeria.json — per-platform link state + one combined item list + a pending_read queue carrying each key's platform), notify.py (proactive voice + [SISTEMA] note, shared throttle), brief.py (the combined numbered brief the brain sees), and dispatch_tag ([[msg.*]] routes by item.platform). Both connectors write the unified store; the single `mensajeria` widget reads it. See .meshkore/docs/architecture/zaelar-hermes-federation.md. Future slots: LinkedIn, X, email. **V2-008 (reshape STATELESS, gated BRAIN=nucleo):** ingest.py adds the bus seam — under nucleo the connectors STOP triaging/storing and only PUBLISH `connector.msg` (incoming, dedup by messageId) + `connector.status` (link+QR), and drain `msg.mark_read` (a MarkReadInbox per platform); triage+store move INTO the `mensajeria` widget owner (backed). triage.py/store.py/notify.py stay in place as the still-live duo/hermes path and as the classifier/store implementation the widget delegates to — their physical retirement is deferred to the entierro (V2-009), per strangler-fig. meshkore/ (cluster channel) is NOT part of the personal-message inbox (peers ≠ personal msgs; its stateless conversion, if wanted, belongs with the cluster-security work in V2-010).
Evaluation harness with persona-based test runs (text-level bot-vs-bot + judge)

Voice tester (INI-013) — a 2nd LiveKit participant that SPEAKS to zaelar (TTS) and LISTENS (STT), driving scenarios with a DeepSeek brain to detect things to improve (latency/turns/memory/agenda/widgets/robustness). Reuses the persona/judge/analyze/report logic of the prior sim candidate; transport is native LiveKit. Runnable/observable without a human mic. Dedicated key TESTER_AIMLAPI_KEY (never committed).

(v2 · CONSTRUIDO V2-001) Sistema Nervioso — pub/sub de señales in-process (asyncio, generalización de voice/observer.py) con patrones fnmatch + emit_sync loop-agnóstico (call_soon_threadsafe, entrega cross-loop job-thread↔uvicorn). bus/log.py = log durable de eventos en SQLite (zaelar.db, tabla events, WAL) enganchado como sink. bus/sse.py = puente SSE al frontend: voice/observer.py re-expresado como suscriptor del topic `observer` (GET /events idéntico). Transporte HÍBRIDO (llamadas directas en la ruta caliente de voz + eventos para lo async/fan-out). NADA de Kafka/broker.

(v2 · CONSTRUIDO V2-004→V2-008; **cerebro por defecto tras el entierro de Hermes, V2-009 · BRAIN=nucleo**) Cerebro propio de dos velocidades que SUSTITUYE a brains/ (Hermes retirado). FlashBrain (nucleo/flash/ — código propio reflejo, sub-segundo: router + cliente de modelo rápido con modelo POR INVOCACIÓN + gestor de frontend/widgets + lanzador de procesos + escalado; enchufado al motor de voz como provider livekit.agents.llm.LLM, cron.create/cancel → nucleo/scheduler). BÚSQUEDA WEB COMPARTIDA (nucleo/websearch.py, V2-022): primitivo propio model-agnóstico usado por AMBOS cerebros — el FlashBrain por la tool web_search (dato directo + síntesis, resuelto EN el turno, off-hot-path vía asyncio.to_thread) y el SlowBrain por WebSearch/WebFetch nativos del CodeAgent (dispatch._tools_for) para informes con datos actuales; proveedor POR CAPAS calidad-primero (respuesta-IA Perplexity/Tavily → snippets Brave → gratis DuckDuckGo, auto-upgrade por key); NAVEGAR un marketplace (Amazon/Wallapop) es otra cosa = el navegador (automate_web). Loop orquestador (nucleo/loop.py ~1 Hz + nucleo/scheduler.py cron PROPIO respaldado por memory.journal + nucleo/cron_api.py = /api/cron del panel ⏰ + nucleo/sparks.py chispas doble-gate: tareas programadas + chispas + dispara el consolidador off-hot-path + reporta por voz+UI; SUSTITUYE al cron nativo de Hermes; montado en el lifespan con BRAIN=nucleo). SlowBrain (nucleo/agentes/ — interfaz CodeAgent + adaptador Claude Code headless `claude -p` + adaptador Codex + factoría get_agent() por config; nucleo/memory_agent.py ★ = agente de MEMORIA, único escritor a memory/, compone contexto mínimo por heurística+router LLM barato; nucleo/mem_processor.py ★ = el CORAZÓN de escritura (V2-013): LLM LOCAL qwen2.5:3b que DESTILA cada turno del operador en PÍLDORAS curadas (dato canónico + metadatos) y decide DESCARTAR/ESTADO/CORTO/LARGO + importancia dinámica + slot, off-hot-path, fail-open a la heurística de memory_agent; nucleo/dispatch.py = dispatcher que compone prompt dinámico [contexto+tarea] → CodeAgent con modelo por invocación, consume escalate.requested del bus y entrega por voz+UI). Endurecimiento (deny-tools para input no confiable hacia el CodeAgent) = V2-010.

(v2 · NÚCLEO CONSTRUIDO en V2-002; INTEGRADA en V2-003; CORAZÓN DE ESCRITURA en V2-013) Memoria central tipo humana, 100% local, un solo fichero SQLite zaelar.db (WAL, en memory/_data/) — substrato compartido que escriben FlashBrain, el agente de memoria y los widgets, y lee el retriever en la ruta caliente (ms). REGLA DE ORO (V2-013): LLM al ESCRIBIR (off-hot-path, el CORAZÓN nucleo/mem_processor.py = qwen2.5:3b local que DESTILA píldoras + decide dónde/importancia/slot), queries DIRECTAS al LEER (sin LLM: state µs + recent_short entero + query RRF off-loop). Cada recuerdo es una PÍLDORA = dato canónico (text) + metadatos (schema v2: slot=clave canónica del hecho singular → supersede/dedup EXACTO; meta=JSON libre). Módulos: db/schema (tablas state·memories[+slot·meta]·vec_memories·fts_memories·edges·episodic·journal; SCHEMA_VERSION=2, migración ALTER idempotente) · queue+writer (único escritor, embeddings al insertar) · embeddings (embeddinggemma 768 vía Ollama, fallback fastembed, degradación determinista) · retriever (sqlite-vec vector + FTS5 keyword → RRF k=60 → score α·rel+β·rec+γ·imp+δ·uso → graph_expand) · state (tabla fija, µs) · graph (aristas) · consolidator (decay Ebbinghaus + dedup + eviction por peso, pinned intocable) · episodic (resumen buscable + carga lazy) · api (fachada + señal memory.updated por el bus). V2-003: ABSORBE el antiguo files/ como capa EPISÓDICA — los bytes pasan al data-dir de la memoria, POST /api/files/upload (ahora memory/server_api.py) llama a memory.write_episode (binario + resumen buscable, carga lazy; se retiró la nota [SISTEMA] de ruta); migración perezosa/idempotente/no-destructiva de files/uploads/ (memory.migrate_inbox en el lifespan); seed_from_hermes.py siembra el perfil del operador desde ~/.hermes (best-effort, solo-lectura); y los widgets escriben lo durable (mensajeria vuelca los mensajes entrantes como kind='msg'). El consumidor de la cola arranca en el lifespan (ZAELAR_MEMORY, def 1). Diseño en .meshkore/docs/architecture/zaelar-memory.md.
